COMPETITIVE BENCHMARK & METHODOLOGY AUDIT

How CalcGrid Compares to 10 Existing Fee Calculator Websites

We audited the 10 leading payment and freelancer calculator sites to identify why international contractors still lose 2%–6% to unmodeled deductions:

Competing Platform What They Solve Well Underserved Need Solved by CalcGrid
01. FeeProbe (feeprobe.com) Clean UI, side-by-side Stripe/PayPal/Wise comparison for US/UK, basic reverse fee calculation. Ignores multi-stage freelance chains (e.g., Upwork -> Payoneer -> Local Bank), no emerging-market corridor restrictions (e.g., Wise receiving limits in Armenia), no local turnover tax, no CSV batch auditing.
02. Teamz Lab Payment Processor Fee Calculator Covers PayPal, Stripe, Wise Business, Payoneer, Bank Wire, and Revolut with currency options. Models single-hop transfers only; does not combine marketplace commission + payout rail FX spread + local tax into a reverse invoice solver; no browser CSV statement auditor.
03. Baznek Platform & Fee Comparison Center Pairwise comparisons (Wise vs Payoneer, Upwork vs Fiverr, Stripe vs PayPal). Lacks country-specific rail availability warnings, SWIFT intermediary bank uncertainty ranges ($10-$30 mid-route deductions), and multi-stage target-net invoice math.
04. HelloFees (hellofees.com) Compares Stripe, PayPal, Square, and Shopify Payments across 60+ countries for e-commerce. Built for e-commerce checkout only; omits Upwork/Fiverr/Lemon Squeezy MoR payouts and emerging-market IE tax regimes (Armenia 1% IT, Georgia 1% SBS).
05. Calcimator Payment Gateway Calculator Highlights forex conversion markups on Stripe, PayPal, Adyen, and Braintree. Single-transaction only; no sensitivity matrix across volume tiers and no CSV reconciliation.
06. GetInvoicePDF Payment Fee Calculator Simple invoice gross-up calculator for Stripe and PayPal. No cross-border payout rails (Payoneer/Wise/SWIFT), no uncertainty bands, and no multi-hop deduction modeling.
07. QuadraPay Payment Gateway Cost Calculator Calculates effective monthly merchant rate across card volume and per-transaction fees. Targets traditional retail card processing; lacks freelancer marketplace and Merchant-of-Record fee structures.
08. DepositFix Payment Gateways Calculator Useful for B2B HubSpot/Stripe checkout cost estimation. No international contractor payout routing or FX spread auditing.
09. Payoneer Native Fee & Checkout Calculator First-party Payoneer volume calculator. Marketing tool that omits side-by-side comparison against Wise mid-market rates or Upwork Direct Contracts.
10. Wise Native Pricing & Corridor Estimator Accurate single-transfer Wise route fees. Does not integrate upstream marketplace commissions (Upwork 0%-15%, Fiverr 20%, Lemon Squeezy 5%+$0.50) or downstream local entrepreneur taxes.
